svg.title: Lighthouse camera path over a minute
svg.desc: An overhead plot and an elevation plot of the same six-point smooth looping camera path. The camera stays on the front side of the sea, moving right then left while looking at the lighthouse.

g.text: The path stays in front of the clock; it does not circle the island.
It follows the smooth curve through :00 → :10 → :20 → :30 → :40 → :50 → :00.
The camera continuously looks toward the tower base.
Camera drift Off holds the :00 view.
